gloss: to fit; to insert; to put on (ring)

definitions.explanation: To put something into a frame, slot, or opening so it fits precisely.
To put jewelry or accessories on one's fingers or hands.

notes:
{嵌|は}める is a transitive verb (⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧) with meanings ranging from fitting things to trapping people.

INTRANSITIVE PAIR: ⟦{嵌|は}まる→嵌まる：04256_hamaru⟧ (to fit into, to be stuck)
- {嵌|は}める: I fit the glass in.
- ⟦{嵌|は}まる→嵌まる：04256_hamaru⟧: The glass fits in.

ASPECT (ている):
{嵌|は}めている indicates something is fitted/worn, or someone has been set up.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- [thing]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧[opening]⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}める — to fit [thing] into [opening]
- [ring/gloves]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嵌|は}める — to put on [ring/gloves]
- [person]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嵌|は}める — to trap/set up [person]
- ⟦{指輪|ゆびわ}→指輪：01744_yubiwa⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嵌|は}める (put on a ring)
- ⟦{手袋|てぶくろ}→手袋：01063_tebukuro⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{嵌|は}める (put on gloves)
- ⟦{罠|わな}→罠：13816_wana⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{嵌|は}める (trap someone)

OFTEN IN HIRAGANA:
This verb is frequently written as はめる due to the kanji's rarity.

COLLOQUIAL USE:
{嵌|は}められた (I was set up!) is common in casual speech when claiming to have been tricked or framed.
